1-Bedroom Home in Historic Killeen with New Flooring!!

This 1-bedroom, 1-bath home nestled in the historic Killeen! This home now features NEW FLOORING in the kitchen and living room, adding a fresh touch to the space. The kitchen offers cabinetry and countertop space.

The bedroom fits a queen-size bed and includes two closets for storage. The bathroom has a pedestal sink and built-in linen cabinetry for added function. Step directly from the bedroom into your fenced backyard—a space ideal for relaxing and gardening.
